claim: ${CLAUDE_EFFORT} in a skill a subagent loads through the Skill tool expands to the subagent's own effort: low pin, not the session effort (effortLevel medium) that record 13 found for a preloaded skill.
purpose: Answers #6908. A fail showing effort=medium means the Skill-tool path now reads the session level, as the preloaded path does: update records.md and the per-skill decisions that rely on this case. An inconclusive whose raw stream shows the subagent ran echo effort=${CLAUDE_EFFORT} literally means this path no longer substitutes the placeholder: record that, do not retry. Before recording, check in the run's raw/ stream that the subagent's Skill call loaded print-effort without an error before the Bash call.
